MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 31.6

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 19
   C. 60
   D. 38

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

10. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

12. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 24.5
   D. 8

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 31.6

2. B — 27.6

3. D — 19.6

4. A — 2/2

5. D — 38
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Perimeter = 2(L + W)
2. Substitute values: P = 2(15 + 4)
3. P = 2(19)
4. P = 38
Final Answer: 38 cm
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

6. C — 1

7. A — 1

8. C — 15.6

9. A — 1

10. A — 3/4

11. A — 10 000 m²

12. B — 7

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Total = number × price each
2. Substitute values: Total = 19 × 85
3. Total = 1615
Final Answer: Ksh 1615
